title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 329 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)

Things are pretty calm. ☀️

Several modest active regions and a broad dark coronal feature are visible, while the solar wind and geomagnetic environment remain quiet.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
